free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'After the expiration period, the account returns to free mode' - free mode carries no transfer, and the only plans are paid: Test 24h, Pro and Lite.
free_tier.notes: The host list marks individual hosts 'Free' or 'Pro'; that is a host class, not a plan. Free mode's actual allowance is not published.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: links only, no storage

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage product; the pricing page says account expiry 'does not delete data or history'

egress.terms: 'I do not limit speed - you will reach the maximum of your connection. Our servers in the EU have a total capacity of 120 Gbps.' Transfer is capped per day instead: 35 GB/day on both paid plans.

interface_detail: JDownloader 2, pyLoad, IDM and an open REST API are listed on the home page; a web panel is available.
tooling: JDownloader 2, pyLoad, IDM. No API documented publicly.
chaining: 35 GB/day is 1.05 TB/month, enough for the 1 TiB monthly volume, but at PLN 29.99 (USD 7.69) it is above the debrid USD 5 bar and adds a Polish-currency payment step.

limits.value: 35 GB/day on Pro and Lite; 35 GB total on the 24-hour test; Pro covers 157 hosts and Lite 120 of 157
none published; the FAQ says a link is checked before quota is spent

limits_note: Lite covers 120 of 157 hosts and excludes Pro hosts; Pro covers all 157. Both paid plans carry the same 35 GB daily transfer.
binding_note: 35 GB/day is 1.05 TB/month, which just clears 1 TiB, so the daily counter is what binds; on Lite the tighter constraint is the 39 missing hosts, not the bytes.

identity_cost.detail: Checkout in PLN by card, wire or crypto ('Global · Wire · Card · Crypto'). Account creation details were not readable without an order flow.

reliability_note: Hosts carry a 'Maintenance' state in the on-page list; quota is shared across every device on the account, so parallel downloads spend the same 35 GB/day.
confidence_note: Prices and transfer quotas are quoted from the vendor's pricing page. The free-mode allowance and the account fields are unverified.

evidence.proved: 'Test 24h 9.99 PLN - Transfer: 35 GB - Hosts: 161'; 'Pro 39.99 PLN / mo - Transfer: 35 GB / day - Hosts: 161'; 'Lite 29.99 PLN / mo - Transfer: 35 GB / day - Hosts: 122 of 161'; 'No. Every plan is a one-time payment. After the expiration period, the account returns to free mode'
'Active services 154', 'Files 115 hosts', and per-host counters such as 'Copycase 0.00 / 35 GB' showing the daily counter shape
the paid plans allow 35 GB per day
the home page lists an open REST API and three downloader integrations
evidence.quote: Native support for JDownloader 2, pyLoad, IDM, and open REST API for building your own solutions.
Pro gives full access to all 157 hosts, including services marked as "Pro". Lite supports 120 hosts at a lower price.

evidence.proved: all devices share the same daily transfer
evidence.quote: There is no device limit, but download sessions share your daily transfer.

price_per_tb_month: PLN 29.99/month Lite, PLN 39.99/month Pro (USD 7.69 and USD 10.26 at 3.899348 PLN/USD on 2026-10-23)
notes: A Polish service with PLN-only pricing, which is why it does not surface in English comparisons. It clears 100 GiB/month on paper (35 GB/day) but misses the USD 5 bar. Currency conversion from the exchangerate-api USD base read on 2026-10-23.
